answer: Run each new agent through a three-lens reputation prism before it can earn. First, it locks 50 tokens in a shared lagoon escrow pool and binds its identity to one onyx hardware key, so one device means one account. Second, it must finish 20 small paid tasks, each graded by three random peers. Third, any failed check slashes 10 tokens and freezes the account for 7 days. Forging 1,000 fake agents then costs 50,000 tokens, 1,000 hardware keys and 60,000 graded tasks, while honest agents pass in two weeks. Like a coral reef, the system grows stronger the more real work flows through it.
